chapter: Trumpet technique: breath, lip and effects
title: Lionel, Punch's young nephew, gives his name
summary: Allen has Lionel Robinson state his name, age and relation to Punch for the tape.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: What's your name, boy? Lionel. Lionel what?
Okay. Put it on there so it comes out clean. Lionel Robinson, right? Come over here. Yeah, come over here. Since you're down on the tape, we want to have your name. What'd you say your name is?
There it is, boy. How old are you, Lionel?
Well, what do you call that fella sitting next to you? My uncle. Uncle what? Punch. He called you Uncle Bud, too. Yeah, yeah. I heard about Uncle Bud already. How do you spell your last name, Lionel?
